title: Attribution Gaps in Zero-Training LLM+OVOD Pipelines: A Fine-Grained Analysis of the CAAP--SNAP Discrepancy
abstract: arXiv:2609.32567v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: LAOD and similar zero-training LLM+open-vocabulary-detector (OVOD) pipelines score two things separately: class-agnostic localization accuracy (CAAP) and semantic naming accuracy (SNAP). The two consistently diverge, and nobody has asked why. This paper asks why, on the full 5,000-image COCO-Val split (27,273 detections) rather than the small subset the original work evaluated on. Object visual complexity turns out not to be the driver -- small and occluded objects are, if anything, localized better than large ones. Vocabulary novelty is: once the LLM's wording falls outside the detector's native category set, localization accuracy falls from 80.9% to 31.6%. That drop is not spread evenly across unfamiliar phrasing, though. Almost all of it comes from cases where the novel wording actually names a different object than the one COCO annotated (true synonyms still score 89.3%; semantically unrelated "noise" labels score 12.0%). translated_title: 零训练LLM+开放词汇检测（OVOD）流水线中的归因差距：CAAP-SNAP差异的细粒度分析
translated_abstract: LAOD及类似的零训练LLM+开放词汇检测器（OVOD）流水线分别对两项指标进行评分：类别无关定位准确率（CAAP）和语义命名准确率（SNAP）。这两项指标始终存在差异，却从未有人探究其原因。本文在完整的5,000张图像COCO-Val分割集（27,273个检测结果）上进行研究——而非原工作所评估的小子集——来探究这一原因。结果表明，物体的视觉复杂性并非驱动因素——小型和被遮挡物体的定位效果反而优于大型物体。真正的驱动因素是词汇新颖性：一旦LLM的措辞超出检测器原生类别集的范围，定位准确率就会从80.9%降至31.6%。不过，这种下降并非均匀分布在生疏措辞上。几乎所有的下降都来自于新颖措辞实际命名的物体与COCO标注不同的情形（真正的同义词仍能取得89.3%的分数；而语义无关的“噪声”标签仅得12.0%）。
tldr: 该研究在完整COCO-Val数据集上首次揭示了零训练LLM+OVOD流水线中CAAP与SNAP差异的根源在于词汇新颖性而非物体视觉复杂性——当LLM措辞超出检测器原生词汇表时定位准确率从80.9%骤降至31.6%，且这一下降主要源于新颖措辞实际命名了与标注不同的物体，而非同义词表述问题。
